entities.name: Hussite Wars
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Series of wars fought in the Kingdom of Bohemia (1419–1434) following the execution of Jan Hus, pitting Hussite reformers against five papal crusades. The wars demonstrated early national resistance to papal authority.
